Strings.addon.title: Passengers
Strings.addon.description: Your cabin manifest: every group of passengers aboard with VIPs and wanted passengers flagged, where they're going, how long you've got and what they pay, plus your cabins.
Strings.js.wanted_aboard: ⚠ WANTED PASSENGERS ABOARD · keep clear of security scans
Strings.js.empty: No passengers aboard. Passenger missions are on the station's mission board, under Passenger Lounge.
Strings.js.wanted_note: Wanted passengers aboard: being scanned by station or system security can get you fined.
Strings.js.vip_note: VIPs aboard: they may not like hull damage, interdictions or going somewhere dangerous.
